component.name: FileHarbor
component.summary: A file manager with its tools built in

description.p: FileHarbor is a file manager for Linux, built as a fork of Nemo. It keeps Nemo's fast, mature engine and adds the tools you usually leave the file manager for, all as tabs in the same window.

ul.li: An embedded terminal that follows the folder you are in
A text editor with syntax highlighting for about 170 languages, Markdown and MDX preview, and Prettier formatting
An image editor with background removal, camera RAW support and batch resize
A media player for video and music with trim, convert and GIF maker
A Storage page that shows what is using your disk
Themes you can change live, remote connections and an extension system

description.p: FileHarbor is based on Nemo and is not affiliated with Linux Mint or the Nemo project.
